card.situation:
Solicitation for Firm-Fixed Price janitorial services (base + 4 option years) at the USACE Tulsa District Robert S. Kerr Powerhouse in Sallisaw, Oklahoma, set aside for Total Small Business under NAICS 561720.
Reached the owner because Red Cedar is an Oklahoma-based, NAICS 561720 exact-match small business with directly relevant federal janitorial past performance and eligible set-aside status.
reasons_for: Red Cedar holds an exact NAICS 561720 match and three directly relevant federal janitorial contracts — including a $1.24M GSA Oklahoma City Federal Building custodial contract — that exceed the incumbent's $282,000 total contract value and demonstrate competitive past performance [profile: past performance, Custodial services Oklahoma City Federal Building].

The firm qualifies for the Total Small Business set-aside and its Oklahoma City base places Sallisaw (~160 miles) within the owner's 200-mile rule, making mobilization and staffing feasible [set_aside_note: 'Red Cedar Facility Services can claim this — the firm qualifies as a small business'].

CIMS-GB certification, e-Verify enrollment, and OSHA 30 supervisors signal a compliance posture well-aligned with FAR sustainability clauses and the solicitation's responsibility standards [profile: CIMS-GB certified, e-Verify, OSHA 30 supervisors].
reasons_against: Active SAM registration is not confirmed in the firm profile, yet the solicitation explicitly states that firms without active SAM at time of quote and award will not be eligible — this must be verified immediately or the quote cannot be submitted [d8c230fb-descript-p0-ec4d2e32].

A NIST/SPRS score is required by the solicitation and firms without one are deemed NON-RESPONSIBLE, but the firm profile makes no mention of a NIST score having been entered or maintained [d8c230fb-descript-p0-08b5320a: 'Those without a NIST score will be deemed NON-RESPONSIBLE'].

The incumbent (Reliance Contractors Inc) holds an existing relationship with the Contracting Officer and site familiarity at the powerhouse/industrial facility, a setting not explicitly referenced in Red Cedar's past performance, creating a competitive disadvantage on past performance evaluation [d8c230fb-descript-p0-08b5320a: 'The Incumbent Contractor is: Reliance Contractors Inc'].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB/EDWOSB) headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, providing professional janitorial and custodial services under NAICS 561720. We are registered and active in SAM.gov and fully eligible under the Total Small Business set-aside for Solicitation W912BV26QA086.

Our federal janitorial portfolio includes custodial services at the GSA Oklahoma City Federal Building ($1.24M, 2022–2025), housekeeping support at the VA Oklahoma City Health Care System outpatient clinic ($420K, 2023–2025), and janitorial services at an Oklahoma state office complex ($610K, 2020–2023). These contracts demonstrate sustained performance across high-traffic federal and institutional facilities requiring floor care, restroom sanitation, trash and recycling management, and green cleaning protocols.

Red Cedar holds CIMS-GB (Green Building) certification, reflecting our commitment to environmentally responsible cleaning practices aligned with federal sustainability requirements. Our supervisors hold OSHA 30 credentials, and all employees are enrolled in e-Verify. We utilize a quality control CMMS logging system to document inspections, corrective actions, and service delivery in real time.

Our Oklahoma City base places the Robert S. Kerr Powerhouse in Sallisaw, Oklahoma, approximately 160 miles from our operations center — well within our standard service radius. We are prepared to staff, mobilize, and sustain performance across the base period and all four option years on a Firm-Fixed Price basis.

Red Cedar is ready to deliver reliable, compliant, and cost-effective janitorial services to the USACE Tulsa District.
questions_for_co: SAM Registration Verification — The solicitation requires active SAM registration at time of quote, award, and throughout performance [req d8c230fb-descript-p0-ec4d2e32]. Will the Contracting Officer confirm whether SAM registration status will be verified at the time of quote submission, and is there a grace period if a registration lapses between quote submission and award?

NIST/SPRS Score Requirement — The solicitation states that offerors without a NIST score in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) will be deemed NON-RESPONSIBLE. Can the Contracting Officer confirm the minimum acceptable NIST SP 800-171 self-assessment score, and whether a score of any value (including negative) satisfies the responsibility determination, or whether a threshold applies?

Amendment Tracking and Submission — The solicitation requires all posted amendments to be signed and submitted with the quote [req d8c230fb-descript-p0-d271f9e5]. Can the Contracting Officer confirm the definitive location (SAM.gov notice page or PIEE) where all amendments will be posted, and whether unsigned amendments included inadvertently will render a quote non-conforming?

SAM Annual Renewal During Option Years — The solicitation requires SAM registration to remain active throughout contract performance [req d8c230fb-descript-p0-7d539f76]. If a contractor's SAM registration lapses during an option year renewal period, what is the cure process and will the government issue a cure notice before taking adverse action?

Incumbent Transition and Site Access — The incumbent contractor is Reliance Contractors Inc. Will the government provide a transition period or site orientation for the incoming contractor, and is a pre-award site visit available for offerors to assess the Robert S. Kerr Powerhouse facility prior to quote submission?
